configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build against release libtorch (Windows: third_party/libtorch-release; macOS ships release-only libtorch, this de-O0s the host/applets). Use this for training-speed measurements — debug torch/hosts are 10-50x slower.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug host/applets (Windows additionally links the separate debug libtorch, third_party/libtorch-debug — slow at runtime by design)

configurePresets.name: release-notorch
configurePresets.description: Release build of libcaliper + Metal renderer + embed C ABI with NO libtorch (CALIPER_WITH_TORCH=OFF: no download, no torch applets, no torch tests). The configuration the Python extension builds against, so it can share a process with Python's own torch.
